question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Microsoft)

calls.reasoning: Consensus Q1 FY27 EPS ~$4.71 (non-GAAP basis, ex-OpenAI). MSFT beat 8 straight quarters; underlying beats over last 4 quarters ~+12.5%, +5.6%, +5%, +4% -> operational ~$4.90-4.93. GAAP adds OpenAI equity-pickup (FY26 swings: -0.41, +1.0, ~0, +0.07) and occasional mark-ups of other private stakes (Anthropic +$0.33 in Q4 from May Series H). In Jul-Sep 2026 no closed primary round for OpenAI (only $7B tender at $852B) or Anthropic (S-1 filed Oct 26), so a modest net OpenAI drag is plausible, with small tail of an Anthropic mark-up. Median ~$4.88. No human market found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi none).

calls.dossier:
- Resolution: GAAP diluted EPS in MSFT Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended Sep 30, 2026) press release, scheduled Oct 28, 2026 after close. It resolves off the GAAP line, not the non-GAAP or 'excluding OpenAI' figure.
- Event window: quarter Jul 1 -> Sep 30, 2026; release Oct 28, 2026. As of Oct 27, 2026 the quarter is 100% elapsed and the release is not yet out.
- Q1 FY27 guidance (Jul 29, 2026 call; Fool transcript): revenue $89.85-90.95B; COGS $29.6-29.8B; opex $16.8-16.9B; other income/expense about -$100M EXCLUDING OpenAI impacts; tax rate ~20%. Arithmetic at midpoints with 7.44B diluted shares gives ~$4.70.
- Consensus (FactSet via previews, Oct 2026): adjusted EPS $4.71-4.72; revenue ~$90.6-90.7B. Some sources list an EPS estimate of $4.82, possibly a GAAP-labelled estimate.
- Beat history (MarketBeat): beat 8 of the last 8 quarters. Q4 FY26 non-GAAP $4.74 vs $4.24 consensus (that included a $0.27 Anthropic gain). Q1 FY26 non-GAAP $4.13 vs ~$3.67.
- Recent GAAP EPS history: Q1 FY26 $3.72 (OpenAI -$0.41); Q2 FY26 ~$5.16 (OpenAI recap dilution gain ~$7.6B); Q3 FY26 $4.27 (OpenAI -$14M, ~0 EPS); Q4 FY26 $4.81 (OpenAI +$0.07, Anthropic gain +$0.27, offset partly by Xbox severance/impairments).
- OpenAI accounting: equity method, ~27% stake. Share of OpenAI losses is offset by dilution gains when OpenAI issues shares at higher valuations (10-Q for Mar 2026; om.co).
- OpenAI events in Jul-Sep 2026: $7B employee tender closed Aug 10 at the same $852B valuation (a buyback, not a new issue). A new ~$30B round at $1.25T pre-money was reported Oct 22, not closed before Sep 30. Unknown: whether any tranches of the March $122B round were funded in-quarter.
- Anthropic: Microsoft recorded a $3.2B gain in Q4 FY26 tied to the May 2026 Series H ($965B). I found no priced Anthropic round or tender in Jul-Sep 2026. S-1 filed Oct 26, 2026 (after quarter end).
- Diluted shares: 7,443M in Q4 FY26; 7,445M in Q3 FY26.
- Searched but not found: an explicit analyst estimate of the OpenAI equity-method impact for Q1 FY27; an exact Microsoft statement on whether OpenAI results are recorded with a lag.
- Status quo: GAAP EPS ≈ operating EPS (guidance/consensus plus the usual beat) plus a net OpenAI/investment item whose sign has varied quarter to quarter (-$0.41 to +$1.0).

calls.reasoning: Guidance implies ~$4.70 ex-OpenAI; consensus $4.71-4.73. MSFT has beaten 8 straight quarters, with underlying beats of ~$0.15-0.30, so operating EPS is ~$4.90-4.95. GAAP adds the OpenAI equity-method line. With no dilutive OpenAI round closed in Jul-Sep 2026 (only a flat $7B tender), losses are less likely to be offset by dilution gains, so I expect a modest drag (~-0.05 to -0.15) with a fat lower tail (Q1 FY26 was -0.41). There is a small upside tail if Anthropic is remeasured off its Sep secondary at ~$1.17T. Market check per runs: possibly a thin Polymarket beat contract (~$4.8k volume, 81-88% Yes, threshold disputed $4.71/$4.82), a near-miss and evidence only; no Kalshi or bookmaker market.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on the evidence: consensus is ~$4.71, MSFT has beaten 8 straight quarters, the resolution is off the GAAP line, and no OpenAI primary round or Anthropic repricing round closed in-quarter. Their medians (4.88-4.92) differ only in how they weigh the OpenAI drag against the size of the beat. Factual disputes: (1) Q4 FY26 Anthropic gain $0.27 vs $0.33 vs $0.35 per share; this doesn't affect Q1 because no run includes an Anthropic markup in its median. (2) Whether a Polymarket contract exists and its threshold ($4.71 vs $4.82); I can't settle this without web access, and it's thin and a near-miss either way, so it is weak upside evidence only. Judgment: in the first quarter after the recap with no dilutive OpenAI issuance, HLBV losses on a ~27% stake could be material, so I set the median slightly below the runs at 4.87 with a slightly fatter low tail; escape masses are kept small (an outsized dilution gain above, an extreme loss below). I agree with the runs' reference class.
